prompt.prompt: Analyze user retention by signup month - show how many users from each month are still active

result.sql:
SELECT 
          u.id,
          u.email,
          u.display_name,
          u.created_at as signup_date,
          COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as session_count,
          COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as conversation_count,
          MAX(GREATEST(s.created_at, c.created_at)) as last_activity
        FROM users u
        LEFT JOIN sessions s ON u.id = s.user_id
        LEFT JOIN agent_conversations c ON u.id = c.user_id
        GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.display_name, u.created_at
        ORDER BY last_activity DESC;
result.explanation: Generated SQL for: Cohort analysis
